note: Title artwork localization, following Z3.1's English wordmark and translated subtitle treatment. Rengoku-hen remains the title spelling in prose catalogs.
subtitle_basis_note: Producer Terada explains that 連獄 derives from 煉獄, between heaven and hell, with the first character changed like the other Z3 subtitles. Purgatory Chapter is this project's English rendering, not an official English title.
